name: Custom3DShaderBackend
description: Backend for applying custom WebGL GLSL shaders to GDevelop 3D objects and CRT-style 3D post-processing passes.
shortDescription: Custom GLSL backend for 3D object materials and 3D post-processing.
author: Twillion

eventsFunctions.name: Apply3DMaterialShader
eventsFunctions.description: Replace compatible 3D mesh materials on selected objects with a custom GLSL ShaderMaterial.

parameters.name: VertexShader
parameters.description: Complete GLSL vertex shader. Leave empty to use the default backend vertex shader.

parameters.name: FragmentShader
parameters.description: Complete GLSL fragment shader. Leave empty to use the default backend material shader.

parameters.name: UseOriginalTexture
parameters.description: Bind original material texture as uMap

eventsFunctions.name: Restore3DMaterialShader
eventsFunctions.description: Restore original Three.js material assignments saved before applying a custom shader.

eventsFunctions.name: Set3DMaterialShaderNumberUniform
eventsFunctions.description: Set or create a numeric uniform on custom material shaders applied to selected 3D objects.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set material shader uniform _PARAM1_ on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_

eventsFunctions.name: Set3DMaterialShaderColorUniform
eventsFunctions.description: Set or create a vec3 color uniform on custom material shaders applied to selected 3D objects.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set material shader color uniform _PARAM1_ on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_;_PARAM3_;_PARAM4_

eventsFunctions.name: Start3DPostShader
eventsFunctions.description: Apply a custom GLSL fullscreen shader pass to the rendered 3D scene, using the same render-target approach as CRT+.

parameters.name: Layer3D
parameters.description: 3D layer. Leave empty to process all 3D rendering.

parameters.name: FragmentShader
parameters.description: Complete GLSL fragment shader. Leave empty to use the default backend post shader.

eventsFunctions.name: Set3DPostShaderFragment
eventsFunctions.description: Replace the active custom 3D post-process fragment shader.

eventsFunctions.name: Set3DPostShaderNumberUniform
eventsFunctions.description: Set or create a numeric uniform on the active 3D post-process shader.

eventsFunctions.name: Set3DPostShaderColorUniform
eventsFunctions.description: Set or create a vec3 color uniform on the active 3D post-process shader.
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set post shader color uniform _PARAM0_ to _PARAM1_;_PARAM2_;_PARAM3_

eventsFunctions.name: Custom3DPostShaderIsEnabled
eventsFunctions.description: Check if the custom 3D post-process shader is enabled.

eventsFunctions.name: Custom3DMaterialShaderIsApplied
eventsFunctions.description: Check if selected 3D objects have custom material shaders applied.

eventsFunctions.name: Custom3DMaterialShaderCount
eventsFunctions.description: Return the number of ShaderMaterial instances managed on the first selected object.

eventsFunctions.name: Custom3DShaderLastError
eventsFunctions.description: Return the last backend, material, or post-process shader error.

eventsFunctions.name: Default3DMaterialVertexShader
eventsFunctions.description: Return the backend default complete material vertex shader.

eventsFunctions.name: Default3DMaterialFragmentShader
eventsFunctions.description: Return the backend default complete material fragment shader.

eventsFunctions.name: Default3DPostFragmentShader
eventsFunctions.description: Return the backend default complete post-process fragment shader.
